Keizer Morning Ride

Keizer, OR · Road

Keizer Morning Ride is a road group ride in Keizer, OR. It rolls every Tuesday at 10:00 am from Keizer Station shopping center, south side of REI.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Keizer Morning Ride group ride

A Tuesday morning ride from Keizer Station that the Salem Bicycle Club runs as a weekly ride. Routes and pace are on each dated listing.
